sql: SELECT julianday(T2.STOP) - julianday(T2.START) FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN medications AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first = 'Elly' AND T1.last = 'Koss' AND T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Acetaminophen 160 MG'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.PATIENT), T2.DESCRIPTION FROM encounters AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Second degree burn'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.patient) FROM encounters AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE substr(T1.DATE, 1, 4) = '2010' AND T1.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Contact dermatitis'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.DESCRIPTION FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN medications AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first = 'Joye' AND T1.last = 'Homenick'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.START FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.maiden = 'Adams'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.ID FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.birthplace = 'Pembroke MA US'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Diabetic diet'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN medications AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG' AND substr(T2.START, 1, 4) >= '1948'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN conditions AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Cystitis'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.DESCRIPTION FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first = 'Major' AND T1.last = 'D''Amore'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.patient) FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN conditions AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.patient) FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN medications AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.DESCRIPTION FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.address = '179 Sydni Roads Taunton MA 02780 US'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.DESCRIPTION FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.ssn = '999-15-3685'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN T2.deathdate IS NULL THEN julianday(substr(datetime('now'), 1, 10)) - julianday(T2.birthdate) ELSE julianday(T2.deathdate) - julianday(T2.birthdate) END / 365) FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension' AND T2.gender = 'M'
SELECT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN observations AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Weight' AND T2.VALUE = 61.97 AND T2.UNITS = 'kg'
SELECT T2.birthdate FROM medications AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG' AND T2.gender = 'M' LIMIT 5
